items.title: Disney's official Avengers: Doomsday film file
items.summary: Disney lists Avengers: Doomsday for December 18, 2026 and says heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course.
items.analysis: Tier S anchor intel. Use this to evaluate universe-collision, Incursion and crossover theories.

items.title: New trailer and poster released by Marvel Studios
items.summary: Disney's July 2026 press release confirms the Russo brothers as directors and a large ensemble spanning multiple Marvel teams and legacy characters.
items.analysis: Official production/cast anchor. Strongly useful when judging crossover and character-presence theories.

items.title: AP fall preview spotlights Doomsday's massive crossover
items.summary: Recent AP coverage describes Doomsday as a huge ensemble bringing together Avengers, Wakandans, New Avengers, Fantastic Four and X-Men under the Russo brothers.
items.analysis: High-quality independent reporting. Useful structural support, but still below first-party material.

items.title: Marvel's pre-Doomsday viewing push gets unusually specific
items.summary: Recent reporting says Marvel and Disney+ assembled a Countdown to Doomsday viewing guide that includes MCU multiverse material and legacy X-Men movies.
items.analysis: Interesting contextual signal for legacy-universe importance, but the exact movie plot still cannot be inferred from a watchlist alone.
